Verses.1: On that day, Jesus left the house and was sitting by the sea.
Verses.2: Such large crowds gathered around Him, so He got into a boat and sat down. The whole crowd stood on the shore.
Verses.3:
Then He told them many things in parables.
Jesus said, "Behold! A sower went out to sow their seed.
Verses.4: As they sowed, some of the seeds fell beside the road, and the birds came and ate them up.
Verses.5: Other seeds fell to rocky places without much soil for them. They sprang up quickly because the soil lacked depth.
Verses.6: Then, when the sun rose, they were scorched. They withered away since they lacked deep roots.
Verses.7: Other seeds fell among the thorns. The thorns grew and choked them.
Verses.8: Now, other seeds fell on good soil. They produced a crop a hundred, sixty, or thirty times what was sown.
Verses.9: Whoever has ears, let them hear. "
Verses.10: Then the disciples came to Him and asked, "Why do You speak to them in parables?"
Verses.11: And Jesus answered them, "The knowledge of the Kingdom of Heaven's mysteries has been given to you, but not to them.
Verses.12: Whoever has will be given more, and they will have an abundance. Whoever does not have, even what they have, will be taken away from them.
Verses.14:
The prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled in them:

	'You will be ever listening, but never understanding.
	You will be ever looking, but never perceiving.
Verses.15:
For the heart of this people has grown insensitive,
		with their ears, they hardly hear,
		and they have closed their eyes.
	Otherwise, they might see with their eyes,
		hear with their ears,
		understand with their hearts, and return,
	and I would heal them.'
Verses.16: But blessed are your eyes because they see and your ears because they hear.
Verses.17: For truly I say to you, that many prophets and righteous people longed to see what you see, and did not see it. They longed to hear what you hear, and did not hear it.
Verses.44: "The Kingdom of Heaven is like a treasure hidden in a field. When someone found it, they hid it again. Overjoyed by their discovery, they go and sell everything they have and buys that field."
Verses.45: "The Kingdom of Heaven is also like a merchant in search of beautiful pearls.
Verses.46: They once came across one pearl of exceptional worth. Upon finding it, they went and sold everything they had and then bought it."
